verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS feedback tool publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Canny's source code is available or openly licensed. The pack covers only the hosted product, SDK and widget install docs, the API reference, the MCP server, and integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
